APPROVE. The quote handling and the shebang check are moved into helpers with identical logic (`ref i` keeps the backslash skip, and the `-1`/`i` returns are preserved), and extracting them removes two nested `if` chains, so complexity drops well below 15 with no evident build or warning problems.

I judged this from the diff alone, since the repository isn't available here, so I haven't built it or run the tests.
